verdict.rationale: Shopify's payments page says merchants can accept cards, wallets, installments and crypto from day one. Community reports confirm a built-in Shopify Payments module (running on Stripe) and a 1% surcharge for third-party gateways, which together show integrated processing is the default path. Payouts exist but one merchant reports recurring payout freezes from address re-verification. Missing for 10: published card rates, fraud tooling, first-party payout documentation, and evidence of reliable payouts outside the US mainland.
